instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update `frontend/src/index.css` to import `@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk`, `@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans`, and `@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono`. Set `--font-heading: 'Space Grotesk Variable', sans-serif;` and `--font-sans: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;`.
2. Implement smooth Lenis scrolling in `frontend/src/App.tsx` or a custom `SmoothScrollProvider` wrapper.
3. Build an original SVG geometric shield/radar mark in the fixed Glass Nav with brand label 'ZC // SOC-DEFENSE'.
4. Create the Interactive Threat Simulation Lab component where recruiters and visitors can test Zeel's triage methodology.

5. Ensure backend `/api/contact` route in FastAPI `backend/routers/contact.py` stores inquiries in MongoDB `inquiries` collection with validation, and seed initial verified telemetry in `backend/seed.py`.
6. Make sure every button, input, accordion, and filter has precise `data-testid` attributes as specified in accessibility guidelines.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not produce generic AI template styling with centered default cards. Use tight letter tracking on headings, Swiss brutalist borders with 1px slate strokes, terminal glowing micro-badges, and generous padding.
Never use pure black #000000; use rich obsidian #090B0E with emerald and radar cyan accents.
Ensure all motion/framer-motion animations have fallback for `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Use sonner for form success notifications.
